decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan; Flood Risk Assessment; 25.361 - P1; 25.361 - P2.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing building or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The glazing serving the additional side window at ground floor, as seen along the proposed North elevation of the development indicated on drawing No.25.361 - P1, shall be in obscured glass with an equivalent obscuration as level 3 on the Pilkington Obscuration Range and the window shall be non-opening unless the parts of the window which can be opened are more than 1.7 metres above the floor of the room in which the window is installed. The glazing shall not be altered without the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining and neighbouring properties

Notwithstanding the submitted Flood Rosk Assessment, prior to the commencement of development, details of flood resilience and surface water management measures shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.The submitted details shall demonstrate:a) that the development will not result in a reduction in on-site flood storage capacity, or where any loss occurs, appropriate compensatory measures are provided;b) how flood resilience and flood resistance measures have been incorporated into the development where appropriate; andc) how surface water arising from the development will be managed through sustainable drainage measures, where reasonably practicable.The approved measures shall be implemented in full prior to first use of the extension and thereafter retained.Reason: To minimise flood risk and ensure satisfactory surface water management in accordance with Policies CP28, DMD59, DMD60, DMD61 and DMD62.
description: Single storey side extension and reinstatement of existing utility room window.
